title: Adding a standard FieldConfigProperty requires an editor registry entry too
answers: What do I need to change to add a new field config option?
Why does my new FieldConfigProperty not appear in the options pane?
body: Add the value to FieldConfigProperty enum (packages/grafana-data/src/types/fieldOverrides.ts:FieldConfigProperty, line 183), and also register a matching editor entry in standardFieldConfigEditorRegistry (packages/grafana-data/src/field/standardFieldConfigEditorRegistry.ts). createFieldConfigRegistry (packages/grafana-data/src/panel/registryFactories.ts:createFieldConfigRegistry, ~line 44) iterates standardFieldConfigEditorRegistry keyed by FieldConfigProperty id — an enum value without a matching registry entry is silently dropped from the panel options UI.
applies: Applies to standard/built-in field config properties (not custom per-plugin FieldConfig.custom extensions, which use a separate mechanism).
